transactions.desc: Wynns and the Cubs agreed on a minor-league contract Tuesday.
The Pirates optioned Curtis to Triple-A Indianapolis on Tuesday, Colin Beazley of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.
The Pirates recalled Murdock from Triple-A Indianapolis on Tuesday, Colin Beazley of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.
Susan Slusser of the San Francisco ChronicleThe Giants recalled Bivens from Triple-A Sacramento on Tuesday, per Susan Slusser of the San Francisco Chronicle.
The White Sox recalled Cannon from Triple-A Charlotte on Tuesday, LaMond Pope of the Chicago Tribune reports.
Outman cleared waivers and was outrighted to Triple-A Toledo on Tuesday, Evan Woodbery of MLive.com reports.
The Rockies optioned Adams to Triple-A Albuquerque on Tuesday.
The Rockies optioned Fulford to Triple-A Albuquerque Tuesday.
The Rockies selected Adams' contract from Triple-A Albuquerque to start Tuesday's game against the Nationals.
The Rockies reinstated Goodman (shoulder) from the 10-day injured list and is batting third Tuesday against the Nationals, Thomas Harding of MLB.com reports.
The Mariners optioned Rivas to Triple-A Tacoma on Tuesday.
The Mariners activated Crawford (wrist) from the 10-day injured list Tuesday.
The Brewers designated Ornelas for assignment Tuesday, Adam McCalvy of MLB.com reports.
The White Sox recalled Nishida from Triple-A Charlotte on Tuesday.
The Brewers reinstated Frelick (shoulder) from the 10-day injured list Tuesday, though he's not in the lineup against the Mets, Adam McCalvy of MLB.com reports.
The Cardinals recalled Gorman from Triple-A Memphis on Tuesday.
The Athletics claimed Roycroft off waivers from the Rays.
The Marlins recalled Fulton from Triple-A Jacksonville on Tuesday.
The Yankees selected Topa's contract from Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre on Tuesday.
The Blue Jays recalled Dallas from Triple-A Buffalo on Tuesday.
The Nationals designated Williams for assignment Tuesday.
The Dodgers activated Glasnow (back) from the 60-day injured list Tuesday.
The Dodgers optioned Gervase to Triple-A Oklahoma City on Monday.
The Cubs outrighted Miller to Triple-A Iowa on Monday.
Burgos was recalled from Triple-A Reno prior to Monday's game against the Cubs.
Wilkinson was optioned to Triple-A Sacramento on Monday, Shayna Rubin of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
Molina was recalled from Triple-A Sacramento ahead of Monday's game against the Reds, Shayna Rubin of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
Walker was recalled from Triple-A Sacramento prior to Monday's game against the Reds, Shayna Rubin of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
Whitcomb was recalled from Triple-A Sacramento ahead of Monday's game against the Reds, Shayna Rubin of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
McCray was recalled from Triple-A Sacramento ahead of Monday's game against the Reds, Shayna Rubin of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
